messages.subject: Re: Warning: Log-likelihood was decreasing near the ML solution. EM method may be unstable
parts:
You can check whether it's due to the accelerate = TRUE default. Sometimes its a bit too greedy in its acceleration scheme. Set it to FALSE to see if the error goes away (otherwise, check the log-likelihood iteration history to see if the model appears to be climbing and falling dramatically. Most of these warnings I've found are pretty mundane and can be ignored, but a warning is thrown just in case). 

Phil
